correctness.rationale: For A5 acting by conjugation on its six Sylow-5 groups, the binary permutation module V=F2^6 has submodules exactly 0<C<W<V, C the fixed constant line and W the even-weight hyperplane. Weight and 2-transitivity arguments together with source exact RREF enumeration support that classification. In V^t⋊A5, maximals avoiding the kernel intersect it in maximal invariant submodules; trivial Frattini of A5 then gives Φ(G_t)=W^t. Five Sylow-2 Klein fours act as five disjoint perfect matchings on six points, partitioning all fifteen edges. For each P the commutator [V,P] is three-dimensional span of its three edge pair-sums; their conjugate-core intersection is C. All odd Sylow subgroup Frattinis vanish, yielding Ψ(G_t)=C^t and gap 2^{4t}. Reviewed the complete exact enumerator code, including six Sylow5s, 60 permutations, invariant subspaces and five matchings. Arbitrary t follows algebraically, not by extrapolating finite run.
